name: Rank by Ouroboros
description: Read-only Google Search Console answers for AI assistants: verified properties, top queries and pages, performance trends, period comparisons, high-impression low-CTR quick wins, dropped pages, and URL Inspection status. Every metric comes from the Search Console API. Tools: list_properties, top_queries, top_pages, performance_trends, compare_periods, quick_wins, dropped_pages, inspect_url, account_status. Hosted remote endpoint with OAuth and Dynamic Client Registration; requires an account. Docs: https://ouroborosapps.com/docs/rank. Published in the Official MCP Registry as io.github.LAHutchins91/rank. Made by Ouroboros Apps (https://ouroborosapps.com).
author: Ouroboros
